---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest new functionality or a change to an existing tool
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

<!-- What breaks today, or what you cannot do right now. Describe the pain, not the solution. -->

## Proposed solution

<!-- What you would like to see. Include the CLI syntax, API shape, or config snippet if you have one in mind. -->

```text
your-tool --new-flag
```

## Alternatives

<!-- Workarounds you tried, other tools that do this, or why this has to be built rather than configured. -->

## Scope

- [ ] Small: a patch or a flag, doable in a sitting
- [ ] Medium: a new module or backend
- [ ] Large: a rewrite or a new subsystem

## Will you implement it?

- [ ] Yes, I will send a pull request
- [ ] Maybe, with guidance
- [ ] No, I am only suggesting

> Design proposals usually get better as a discussion, because you get feedback before writing code.
